items.description: Defined date on which Tenant may begin early access to the Premises.
items.name: Early Access Date
items.span_text: “Early Access Date” shall mean and refer to February 1, 2014.

items.description: Tenant may terminate the Lease by written notice to Landlord delivered within five business days after a Continuous Outage.
items.span_text: “Continuous Outage Termination Notice” shall mean and refer to written notice from Tenant to Landlord, delivered within five (5) business days after the occurrence of a Continuous Outage, that Tenant thereby terminates this Lease.

items.anchor_event: date on which any particular payment of Rent is due
items.description: Defined date falling five days after a Rent payment due date.
items.name: Delinquency Date
items.span_text: “Delinquency Date” shall mean and refer to the date that is five (5) days after the date on which any particular payment of Rent is due from Tenant to Landlord.
